# Phase 01.1 — Validation Strategy

> Per-phase validation contract for feedback sampling during execution.
> Derived from `01.1-RESEARCH.md` § "Validation Architecture".

---

## Test Infrastructure

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| **Framework** | Vitest **4.1.10** (`@vitejs/plugin-react` 6.0.4, `jsdom` 30.0.1) |
| **Config file** | `vitest.config.ts` — `fileParallelism: false`, `sequence.concurrent: false` (deliberate: all files share one Postgres; **do not change**) |
| **Quick run command** | `pnpm exec vitest run <path>` |
| **Full suite command** | `pnpm exec vitest run` |
| **Estimated runtime** | ~50 seconds (47 files / 462 tests, all green 2026-08-04) |
| **Build gate** | `pnpm build` |
| **Typecheck** | `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` — **never `pnpm dlx tsc`** (the npm `tsc` package is a deprecated squatter that prints a notice instead of typechecking) |

**Vitest 4 gotcha:** `--reporter=basic` was removed and errors with `Failed to load url basic`. Use the default reporter.

**Known flakes:** `tests/staff/pin-verify-backoff.test.ts` and `tests/actions/venue-authority.test.ts` are timing-sensitive against local Postgres. Re-run before treating a red there as real. Failures in any other file are genuine.

---

## Sampling Rate

- **After every task commit:** `pnpm exec vitest run <touched path>` + `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit`
- **After every plan wave:** `pnpm exec vitest run` (full, ~50s) + `pnpm build`
- **Before `/gsd-verify-work`:** full suite green at **464** (462 existing + 2 new D-13 regressions), `pnpm build` clean, SC1 and SC4 tripwires green
- **Max feedback latency:** 50 seconds

## Wave 0 Requirements

Units under test (must exist before the tests that assert on them):

- [ ] `lib/theme/contrast.ts` — pure WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance `contrastRatio`, no dependency
- [ ] `lib/theme/venue-tokens.ts` — total `resolveVenueTheme`
- [ ] `lib/format/money.ts` — `Intl.NumberFormat` wrapper (replaces the template's hardcoded-FX `money()`)

Test files:

- [ ] `tests/theme/no-third-party-assets.test.ts` — SC1, allowlist of exactly one origin (`https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client`, ACCT-01)
- [ ] `tests/theme/build-assets.test.ts` — SC1 layer 2, reads `.next/static/chunks/*.css`
- [ ] `tests/theme/venue-contrast-guardrail.test.ts` — SC4 proof, exhaustive sweep over the finite curated pairing set. **In v1 the set has one member (Cena's own pairing, D-14)**, which makes this a regression guard on Cena's own AA compliance — currently proven only by hand in `color-contrast.card.html`. The theming milestone grows it by adding rows, not by changing the mechanism. Research's 18 real co-occurrence pairs are the sweep's input; the likeliest failure is `--text-subtle` on `--surface-sunken` at `--text-2xs`, simultaneously the lowest-contrast pair, the smallest type, **and the surface carrying allergen chips**
- [ ] `tests/theme/token-boundary.test.ts` — SC4/D-02 (no Cena hue in the venue namespace) + D-10 (no dark selector on `--venue-*`)
- [ ] `tests/theme/touch-targets.test.ts` — SC3's 44px floor
- [ ] `tests/format/money.test.ts` — pins `currencyDisplay: 'narrowSymbol'` → `"lei"` and the 4-digit HUF grouping, with literal expected strings (ICU data shifts between Node majors)
- [ ] `tests/venues/venue-eur-submission.test.tsx` — G-01-13; critical assertion is exact `["en"]`
- [ ] `tests/actions/create-venue-revalidation.test.ts` — G-01-14; critical assertion is `invocationCallOrder` (`revalidatePath` **before** `redirect`)

No framework install needed. No shared-fixture file needed — the suite has no `conftest`-equivalent and tests are self-contained.

## Manual-Only Verifications

| Behavior | Requirement | Why Manual | Test Instructions |
|----------|-------------|------------|-------------------|
| RO/HU diacritics render correctly | SC1 | A subset can be statically correct and still look wrong | View a venue name containing `ă â î ș ț ő ű` at 1× on a phone in all three families |
| Every Phase 01 surface renders in the new system | SC3 | No snapshot tests exist, and adding them would couple the suite to appearance — which SC2 argues against | Browser pass over signup, login, password reset, dashboard, venue create/edit, venue switcher, staff provisioning, device enrolment |
| One-handed phone usability | SC3 | The 44px floor is necessary, not sufficient | Thumb-reach pass on a real handset |
| Diner vocabulary is mobile-first, intentional and attractive | SC5 | Not a property a unit test can assert | `/gsd-ui-review` |

**SC5 is the weakest-measured criterion. The plan must state this rather than paper over it.** Three of its four sub-claims are assertable (residue enumeration, the 14-allergen vocabulary, the Copywriting Contract rows); the aesthetic claim is a human gate.
